USURER-STRIKE_USURER.title: Strike
USURER-DEFEND_USURER.title: Defend
USURER-PREDATORY_LOAN.title: Predatory Loan
USURER-AUDIT.title: Audit
USURER-AUDIT.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Repay[/gold] {Repay:diff()} [gold]Debt[/gold] and gain [blue]1[/blue] additional [gold]Block[/gold] for each [gold]Debt[/gold] repaid.
USURER-COIN_TOSS.title: Coin Toss
USURER-EASY_CREDIT.title: Easy Credit
USURER-BAILIFF_STRIKE.title: Bailiff Strike
USURER-BAILIFF_STRIKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage twice.
Apply {Lien:diff()} [gold]Lien[/gold] on each hit.
USURER-LEDGER_SLAM.title: Ledger Slam
USURER-LEDGER_SLAM.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you are [gold]Over-Leveraged[/gold], deal {BonusDamage:diff()} additional damage.
USURER-COLLATERAL_SHIELD.title: Collateral Shield
USURER-COLLATERAL_SHIELD.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold], plus additional [gold]Block[/gold] equal to the target's [gold]Lien[/gold].
Apply {Lien:diff()} [gold]Lien[/gold].
USURER-DEBT_COLLECTION.title: Debt Collection
USURER-COOK_THE_BOOKS.title: Cook the Books
USURER-PAYDAY.title: Payday
USURER-AMORTIZE.title: Amortize
USURER-TAX_SWEEP.title: Tax Sweep
USURER-TAX_SWEEP.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Apply {Lien:diff()} [gold]Lien[/gold] to ALL enemies.
USURER-FORECLOSE.title: Foreclose
USURER-FORECLOSE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Foreclose[/gold]: Consume all [gold]Lien[/gold] on the enemy to deal {DamagePerLien:diff()} damage and [gold]Repay[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Debt[/gold] per stack.
USURER-DEBT_RESTRUCTURING.title: Debt Restructuring
USURER-DOUBLE_ENTRY.title: Double Entry
USURER-BAILOUT.title: Bailout
USURER-BAILOUT.description:
[gold]Repay[/gold] ALL of your [gold]Debt[/gold].
Gain {BlockPerDebt:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] for each [gold]Debt[/gold] repaid.
USURER-HOSTILE_TAKEOVER.title: Hostile Takeover
USURER-HOSTILE_TAKEOVER.description:
Destroy the target's [gold]Block[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply {Lien:diff()} [gold]Lien[/gold] and [gold]Borrow[/gold] {Borrow:diff()} [gold]Debt[/gold].
USURER-COMPOUND_INTEREST.title: Compound Interest
USURER-COMPOUND_INTEREST.description: At the start of your turn, if you have any [gold]Debt[/gold], apply {Lien:diff()} [gold]Lien[/gold] to ALL enemies.
USURER-SHADOW_BANKING.title: Shadow Banking
USURER-GARNISH_WAGES.title: Garnish Wages
USURER-GARNISH_WAGES.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Whenever you apply [gold]Lien[/gold] this turn, gain {LienBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
USURER-DEBTORS_PRISON.title: Debtor's Prison
USURER-DEBTORS_PRISON.description: At the start of your turn, apply {Weak:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies that have [gold]Lien[/gold].
USURER-LEVERAGED_BUYOUT.title: Leveraged Buyout
USURER-LEVERAGED_BUYOUT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage, plus {DamagePerDebt:diff()} additional damage for each [gold]Debt[/gold] you have.
USURER-SOVEREIGN_DEFAULT.title: Sovereign Default
USURER-SOVEREIGN_DEFAULT.description:
Prevent turn-end [gold]Debt[/gold] Installment self-damage.
Whenever you are [gold]Over-Leveraged[/gold] at the end of your turn, deal [blue]ceil(Debt / 2)[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
USURER-SYNDICATED_LOAN.title: Syndicated Loan
USURER-SYNDICATED_LOAN.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Remove all [gold]Artifact[/gold] and [gold]Block[/gold] from ALL enemies, then apply {Lien:diff()} [gold]Lien[/gold] to ALL enemies.
[gold]Borrow[/gold] {Borrow:diff()} [gold]Debt[/gold].
USURER-INFERNAL_CONTRACT.title: Infernal Contract
USURER-INFERNAL_CONTRACT.description: Choose 1 of 3 generated 0-cost cards to add to your [gold]Hand[/gold]: [gold]Blood Clause[/gold], [gold]Gold Clause[/gold], or [gold]Soul Clause[/gold].
USURER-INFERNAL_CONTRACT.selectionScreen: Choose a contract clause to add to your Hand.
USURER-GOLDEN_SCALES.title: Golden Scales
USURER-GOLDEN_SCALES.description: Whenever you [gold]Borrow[/gold] [gold]Debt[/gold], apply {Lien:diff()} [gold]Lien[/gold] to a random enemy.
USURER-BLOOD_CLAUSE_TOKEN.title: Blood Clause
USURER-GOLD_CLAUSE_TOKEN.title: Gold Clause
USURER-SOUL_CLAUSE_TOKEN.title: Soul Clause
